description: Site admins only (needs an 'admin'-scoped token). Revoke every browser session, personal access token (repository tokens included) and OAuth grant — for every user (scope 'platform') or for one (scope 'user' + username). Optionally force a password reset (old password stops working, reset email sent) and 2FA re-enrolment (seeds and recovery codes deleted). Confirm by sending `confirm` exactly: 'REVOKE ALL CREDENTIALS' for platform, 'REVOKE <username>' for one user; anything else changes nothing. Platform scope revokes YOUR OWN sessions and tokens too, including the token making this call. Audit-logged. Not covered: SSH keys, passkeys, deploy keys/tokens, CI runners, app installation tokens. Returns counts, actorSignedOut and notCovered.

force_2fa_reenrol.description: Delete TOTP seeds and recovery codes so the user enrols again

force_password_reset.description: Replace the password so the old one stops working, and send the reset email

name: gluecron_revoke_all_credentials
